findings.evidence: The future-opportunity update required a primary-source boundary between monetised automotive intelligent driving, robot/low-speed commercialisation options, and ecosystem technology options. Available issuer material discloses products, a nomination, planned delivery, unspecified orders, POC and cooperation, but not a complete customer-to-cash chain.
findings.fix_required: Register issuer annual-report, IR-record and corporate-news evidence; classify every missing customer, unit, revenue, ASP, margin and cash field; prohibit all unclosed paths from base EPS and target-price inputs.

findings.evidence: 2026H1 formal report/forecast was not present in the collected primary corpus as of 2026-07-23.
findings.fix_required: Keep 2026Q1 unaudited and do not annualise it; use a disclosed public forecast only as a labelled external cross-check until formal interim disclosure.

findings.evidence: Four original broker PDFs and 12 auditable snapshots contain earnings information, but no current auditable broker target-price/method anchor.
findings.fix_required: Set all Street target-price valuation weights to zero, retain revenue/EPS fields as external cross-checks only, and disclose the exhaustion path.

findings.evidence: Customer/vehicle-level revenue, ASP, utilization, order-conversion and project margin are not disclosed despite verified customer, platform and order language.
findings.fix_required: Keep customer/vehicle optionalities out of base EPS and target-price uplift; use only reported segment revenue, margin, working-capital and cash-flow facts for the core model.
